title: CookbookCore: appendItem(_:toAisle:)
description: Add `public mutating func appendItem(_ text: String, toAisle aisle: String)` to `ShoppingList.swift`. Finds the `## <aisle>` heading with a case-insensitive match on the trimmed heading text. Inserts `- [ ] <text>` immediately above the next `##` heading, or at end-of-section if none follows. If no matching heading exists, appends `## <aisle>\n- [ ] <text>\n` at end of file. Aisle heading written with caller-supplied casing. Whitespace: single trailing newline after the inserted item; adds one before new content if file did not end with a newline.
acceptance_criteria: Method signature is `public mutating func appendItem(_ text: String, toAisle aisle: String)`

Given `## produce
- [ ] broccoli
## dairy
- [ ] milk
`, appendItem("carrots", toAisle: "produce") inserts the new line between broccoli and the `## dairy` heading
Given `## Produce\n- [ ] broccoli\n`, appendItem("carrots", toAisle: "produce") inserts under the existing `## Produce` heading (case-insensitive match, no new heading created)

Given `## produce
- [ ] broccoli
`, appendItem("milk", toAisle: "dairy") appends `
## dairy
- [ ] milk
` and leaves the produce section unchanged
Items appearing before the first `##` heading are preserved unchanged
All other sections' line ordering and content are byte-identical after the call

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented appendItem(_:toAisle:) in ShoppingList.swift covering all acceptance criteria: case-insensitive heading match, insertion before next ## heading, end-of-section insertion, new-section creation, and preservation of pre-heading content and other sections.
handoff_summary.risks: None identified. The implementation is additive (new overload) and does not touch existing methods.
handoff_summary.next_action: Ready for tester agent to validate acceptance criteria.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — change is limited to adding a new public method overload; no existing method signatures or logic was altered.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `components(separatedBy: "\n")` line manipulation rather than String index arithmetic to keep the logic readable and avoid the off-by-one risks seen in rangeInText(for:in:). Trailing-newline invariant preserved by detecting whether the last split element is an empty string before inserting.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: All six acceptance-criteria scenarios should be covered by tester: (1) insert between two sections, (2) case-insensitive heading match with existing heading, (3) new section appended when heading absent, (4) pre-heading content preserved, (5) sibling sections byte-identical.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Heading detection requires `## ` (two hashes + space); bare `##` without a space or level-3+ headings are not treated as aisle boundaries, consistent with the spec's canonical form.

conflict_risks: None — change is limited to adding a new public method overload; no existing method signatures or logic was altered.

execution_history.summary: Added `public mutating func appendItem(_ text: String, toAisle aisle: String)` to ShoppingList.swift. The method finds a `##`-level heading by case-insensitive trimmed comparison, inserts the new checklist item just before the next `##` heading (or before the trailing newline when no next heading exists), and appends a new `## <aisle>` section when no matching heading is found. Build passes cleanly.
